run_make_submission_file: run the CLI script to merge OC20 or OC22 split results into a single evalAI submission NPZ file
run_write_predictions: run write_predictions to merge multiple split NPZ result files into one compressed submission file
run_write_is2re_relaxations: run write_is2re_relaxations to extract IDs and energies from ASE trajectory files for IS2RE submissions
run_main: run main to validate split paths and generate a compressed NPZ submission file for evalAI
review_write_is2re_relaxations: review write_is2re_relaxations to understand how it handles both trajectory and hybrid S2EF NPZ input modes
